apps.name: Resona
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client in Material 3 Expressive
apps.localizedDescription: Resona is a YouTube Music client for iPhone and iPad with dynamic cover colours, word-synced karaoke lyrics, downloads and a Material 3 Expressive design.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Lyrics: plain text instead of fake [00:00.00] timing, sync it yourself
- Settings: hide the lyrics developer switches behind 7 taps on the version
- Appearance: player style (large cover / small cover + lyrics), blur strength
- Songtext settings: animation style, translation, romanization
- Storage settings: delete all downloads, clear caches with sizes
- iPad: queue, player menu and lyrics options as a side panel
- Artists: chevron instead of play on cards, 'Play mix' on the artist page
- Downloads: keep downloaded playlists up to date
- Rename the player AirPlay button (clashed with Trop's AirPlayButton)
- Lyrics: fix timing for slowed/sped-up versions, per-song tempo and offset
- Playback: crossfade between songs (off / 1-12 s)
- Lock screen / Control Center: like, shuffle, repeat, AirPlay, safer pauses
- Auto releases on every main build, ESign/AltStore app source, update check
- iPad: lyrics full screen with cover, controls and rest mode
